items.label: Cain's city
items.when: Built when Cain's son Enoch was born, before the Flood (Genesis 4:17); early Genesis has no years, so it is ordered only by the verses.

items.label: Noah's ark
items.when: Finished before the floodwaters came, when Noah was 600 (Genesis 6:14-22; 7:6).

items.label: Noah's altar
items.when: Built as soon as Noah came out of the ark, just before God's covenant of the rainbow (Genesis 8:18-9:17).

items.label: Tower of Babel
items.when: Never finished: the building stopped when the LORD confused the languages (Genesis 11:8), and it is dated by that moment.

items.label: Abram's altar at Shechem
items.when: Built when Abram, aged 75, first came into Canaan from Haran (Genesis 12:4-7).

items.label: Abram's altar at Hebron
items.when: Built after Abram came back from Egypt and parted from Lot, while he was still called Abram, a name changed when he was 99 (Genesis 13:18; 17:1-5).

items.label: Abraham's altar on Moriah
items.when: Built for the binding of Isaac, who was born when Abraham was 100; Abraham died at 175 (Genesis 21:5; 25:7).

items.label: Jacob's pillar at Bethel
items.when: Set up the morning after Jacob's dream of the ladder, as he fled to Laban (Genesis 28:18).

items.label: Pithom and Rameses
items.when: Built after Joseph's generation had died and before Israel set out from Rameses (Exodus 1:6-11; 12:37); the window runs from the earliest date the site gives for Joseph's death to the latest it gives for the Exodus, so it covers both the early and the late Exodus date.

items.label: Golden calf
items.when: Made at Sinai while Moses was on the mountain, in the first year out of Egypt (Exodus 32:1-4).

items.label: Ark of the covenant
items.when: Made at Sinai after the golden calf and placed in the tabernacle when it was set up in the second year (Exodus 37:1; 40:20-21; Deuteronomy 10:3).

items.label: Tabernacle
items.when: Set up on the first day of the first month of the second year after leaving Egypt (Exodus 40:17).

items.label: Bronze snake
items.when: Made in the fortieth year, after Aaron died and Israel left Mount Hor (Numbers 33:38; 21:4-9).

items.label: Gilgal stones
items.when: Set up at Gilgal on the day Israel crossed the Jordan (Joshua 4:19-20).

items.label: Altar on Mount Ebal
items.when: Built by Joshua after the Jordan crossing; the Hebrew, Greek and Qumran copies place this passage at different points in Joshua, all after the crossing and before Joshua 22, so the window runs from the earliest date for the crossing to the latest date for Joshua's death.

items.label: Altar by the Jordan
items.tag: Named Witness by the eastern tribes
items.when: Built when Joshua sent the eastern tribes home at the end of the conquest (Joshua 22:1-10); the window runs from the earliest date for the Jordan crossing to the latest date for Joshua's death.

items.label: Gideon's altar
items.tag: The LORD Is Peace, at Ophrah
items.when: Built when the angel of the LORD called Gideon, just before the sign of the fleece (Judges 6:24).

items.label: Micah's idol
items.when: Made after Israel entered Canaan, when there was no king in Israel (Judges 17:1-6); Judges 17-21 is tied to no judge, so the window runs from the earliest date for the Jordan crossing to the latest date for Saul's crowning.

items.label: Ebenezer stone
items.when: Set up after the ark had stayed twenty years at Kiriath-jearim and before Israel asked for a king (1 Samuel 7:2-12; 8:5); the window runs from twenty years after the earliest date for the ark's capture to the latest date for Saul's crowning.

items.label: Saul's first altar
items.when: Built during Saul's reign, the first altar he built to the LORD; the year is not given, so the whole reign counts (1 Samuel 13:1; 14:35).

items.label: David's palace
items.when: Built after David took Jerusalem in the eighth year of his reign; the exact year is not given (2 Samuel 5:5-11).

items.label: Altar at Araunah's threshing floor
items.when: Built by David in Jerusalem to stop the plague after his census; the year of his reign is not given (2 Samuel 24:18-25).

items.label: Solomon's Temple
items.when: Begun in Solomon's fourth year and finished in his eleventh (1 Kings 6:1, 38).

items.label: Solomon's palace
items.when: Took thirteen years and was finished at the end of the twenty years Solomon spent building the temple and the palace, counted from his fourth year (1 Kings 7:1; 9:10).

items.label: Jeroboam's golden calves
items.when: Made by Jeroboam after the kingdom split; the year is not given, so his whole reign of twenty-two years counts (1 Kings 12:28-29; 14:20).

items.label: Samaria
items.when: Built by Omri during his twelve-year reign (1 Kings 16:23-24).

items.label: Ahab's temple of Baal
items.when: Built by Ahab in Samaria; the year is not given, so his whole reign of twenty-two years counts (1 Kings 16:29-32).

items.label: Ahab's ivory palace
items.when: Built by Ahab; the year is not given, so his whole reign of twenty-two years counts (1 Kings 22:39).

items.label: Hiel's Jericho
items.when: Rebuilt by Hiel of Bethel in Ahab's days, as Joshua had said; the year is not given, so Ahab's whole reign counts (1 Kings 16:34).

items.label: Elijah's altar on Carmel
items.when: Built by Elijah on Mount Carmel in the third year of the drought, in Ahab's reign (1 Kings 18:1, 31-32).

items.label: Ahaz's Damascus altar
items.when: Built by Uriah the priest to the pattern Ahaz sent from Damascus, after Assyria took the city; the year is not given, so Ahaz's whole reign of sixteen years counts (2 Kings 16:2, 9-11).

items.label: Hezekiah's tunnel
items.when: Made by Hezekiah to bring water into the city; the year is not given, so his whole reign of twenty-nine years counts (2 Kings 18:2; 20:20; 2 Chronicles 32:30).

items.label: Nebuchadnezzar's golden statue
items.when: Set up by Nebuchadnezzar in the province of Babylon; the year is not given, so his whole reign counts (Daniel 3:1).

items.label: Altar of the returned exiles
items.tag: Jerusalem, built by Jeshua and Zerubbabel
items.when: Built in the seventh month after the first exiles came home under Cyrus (Ezra 3:1-3).

items.label: Second Temple
items.when: Finished on the third day of Adar in the sixth year of King Darius, about 515 BC (Ezra 6:15).

items.label: Nehemiah's wall
items.when: Finished in fifty-two days, in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, about 445 BC (Nehemiah 2:1; 6:15).

items.label: Herod's Temple
items.when: Herod the Great's rebuilding began about 20 BC and had taken forty-six years by early in Jesus's ministry (John 2:20); the window runs from the earliest start Josephus gives (about 23 BC) to the work's completion in the AD 60s, and it is later than every other building either way.
